program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((regions (find-0-regions g 0)))
    (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)]) ([obj (in-list (objects g 0))])
      (let ((holes (filter (lambda (reg)
                             (all? (lambda (p)
                                     (and (> (first p) (obj-r1 obj)) (< (first p) (obj-r2 obj))
                                          (> (second p) (obj-c1 obj)) (< (second p) (obj-c2 obj))))
                                   reg))
                           regions)))
        (paint-cells out (append* holes) (obj-color obj))))))
